title: A custom role row has a pencil (edit) icon and a three-dot menu; View Permissions is in the menu
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list with at least one custom role.
custom_steps:
1. Find a custom role row.
  2. Look at the icons in the Actions column.
custom_expected:
A custom role row has a pencil (edit) icon and a three-dot menu.

There is no separate eye icon on custom rows — View Permissions is inside the three-dot menu.

(A separate eye icon appears only on the locked system rows Office User and Time Clock User.)
evidence: UI: custom role rows (Parth Cust1/Bilal - Cus) show pencil (edit) + more_vert (3-dot); the 3-dot menu contains View Permissions.
